description: On the bed in front of the hands are several small items, including a yellow plate, a pink macaron-shaped piece, a yellow die, a slice of bread, and a few other toy food pieces. The left hand stays mostly still near the left edge, while the right hand moves in from the right, grips the pink macaron piece as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it leftward, then lowers and releases it onto the center of the yellow plate.
